name: Work & Diligence
overview: Scripture reveals that work is a divinely appointed responsibility, established before the fall when God placed Adam in the garden to cultivate and keep it (Genesis 2:15). Diligence in obeying God's commands is emphasized repeatedly, as seen in the calls to listen and keep His statutes carefully (Exodus 15:26; Deuteronomy 6:17; 11:13). Teaching and living out God's ways with steadfast commitment, including in work and family life, reflects faithful obedience and honors God (Deuteronomy 4:9; 6:7). Thus, work and diligence are integral to practical living, grounded in loving and serving the Lord wholeheartedly.
